symptom: A host candidate build and signed resolution succeeded, but vNext release always dialed the signed Operator endpoint and could not use the restricted CI network's reachable transport for the same publish service.
whyGateMissed: The release path verified signed Operator identity but had no regression case for preserving that identity while routing the protocol through an explicit CI transport endpoint.
earliestDetection: Exercise vNext release transport selection with an execute-mode CI override and require an explicit absolute HTTP(S) endpoint while credential-bearing, malformed, and non-CI overrides fail closed.
